changes: Includes audio driver 1.1.0 with a rebuilt audio path: volume, balance, and app route changes fade smoothly, and Nearfield reports its output latency to macOS.
Sound follows a routed window to the other display within two seconds, and right away when playback starts, an app comes to the front, or the Space changes.

Select Nearfield automatically when a second Studio Display connects and its audio route is ready, with one recovery for apps still playing on the previous output. Manual output choices are respected.
Hide the Nearfield output when fewer than two Studio Displays are connected, even while the app is not running.
When the displays disconnect, return sound to the previous output or the built-in speakers.
Nearfield now requires a Mac with Apple silicon.
